title: The Mists of Avalon
author: Marion Zimmer Bradley
summary: The legend of King Arthur retold from the viewpoint of its women, especially Morgaine, as Christianity spreads across Britain and the priestesses of Avalon struggle to hold on to the old ways.
readIf: you want a long, richly detailed retelling of Camelot centred on its women.
skipIf: you prefer the traditional heroic Arthur or want a fast-moving plot.
